seasonLine: Rich, warm, and grounded colors sit closest to your skin.

wear.name: Cream
wear.why: Cream sits easier against deep warm skin than pure white.

wear.name: Chocolate
wear.why: Chocolate holds the depth of your hair without going flat.

wear.name: Brick red
wear.why: A red with brown in it is the red your warm skin takes.

wear.name: Rust
wear.why: Rust carries the same warmth that already sits in your skin.

wear.name: Camel
wear.why: Camel is a warm neutral, which stays kinder on you than grey.

wear.name: Mustard
wear.why: Mustard picks up the gold in your skin.

wear.name: Olive
wear.why: Olive is warm and muted, so it reads as part of your coloring.

wear.name: Forest green
wear.why: Forest green is deep enough to hold its own next to your skin.

wear.name: Deep teal
wear.why: Deep teal is a cool color with warmth left in it, so it works on you.

wear.name: Aubergine
wear.why: Aubergine gives you a very dark color that is not black.

avoid.name: Baby blue
avoid.why: Baby blue is too cool and too pale to stand next to your depth.

avoid.name: Cool grey
avoid.why: Cool grey pulls the warmth out of your skin.

avoid.name: Fuchsia
avoid.why: Fuchsia is a cold pink, and it works against your warmth.

avoid.name: Pure white
avoid.why: Pure white is a harder light on your skin than cream.
